title: Rinkēvičs officially nominates Kulbergs for Prime Minister
summary_full: On Wednesday, 4 November, President Edgars Rinkēvičs officially nominated Andris Kulbergs, leader of the United List, for the post of Prime Minister.
summary_public: On Wednesday, 4 November, President Edgars Rinkēvičs officially nominated Andris Kulbergs, leader of the United List, for the post of Prime Minister.
